title: Block
description: A reusable bundle of resources with typed parameters.

name.description: Unique per kind. Lower case letters, digits, '-' and '.'.

params.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of the parameters. It must describe an object. Titles and defaults drive the UI form.

items.description: Exactly one entry: resource type → attributes. String values are Go text/template strings over the parameters.

after.description: Resource ids (type:key) that each use of this Block comes after, for example package:nginx. Literal strings, not templates. The named resources must be on the same Target, in another Block use. A use starts only when each of them ended unchanged or applied; else the use is skipped. Uses with no such relation apply in parallel.

restarts.description: Service ids (service:name) that restart when a resource of a use of this Block changes, for example service:nginx. Literal strings, not templates. The services must be on the same Target. Render adds the resource ids of the use to restart_on of each service.
